academic.passage: Mathematical theories play a crucial role in the development of scientific understanding. A theory provides a framework for explaining observations and making predictions. For instance, the theory of relativity allows physicists to understand gravitational effects on time and space. The validation of a theory requires rigorous testing through experiments and peer review. This process ensures that a theory is not only sound but also applicable across different scenarios, thereby enhancing our comprehension of the universe.
